item: The vLLM log view says what it leaves out and the failed-log copy runs off the status probe
summary: The additive keys of the scrubbed log reader (tail_note, scanned_whole, held_back_note, preserved_log_path/reason) are now shown under the server-log view (3 strings x12). The scrubbed copy of a failed start's log (about 4 s at 64 MB) no longer blocks the status poll: the exit is journalled first with the copy pending, a thread writes the copy and a second journal line (exit_log_preserved), and the next start waits for it before truncating the log.
